title: Skydio CEO Adam Bry on why Silicon Valley shouldn’t draw red lines for drone use
brief: In a Decoder podcast interview, Skydio CEO Adam Bry discusses why the drone industry is shifting from consumer toys to autonomous enterprise infrastructure, and argues that Silicon Valley companies should avoid drawing red lines that prevent military and government use of drone technology. Bry emphasizes that Skydio's customers—utilities, public safety, and militaries—use autonomous drones to inspect critical infrastructure and improve outcomes in high-risk operations, and positions the company's focus on US manufacturing as essential as foreign competitors like DJI face government bans.
